About Balloons and Blooms Suites

Balloons and Blooms Suites brings together the expertise of Keepsakes Planning and Weddings Unlimited by Danielle to specialize in hotel room decorations for special occasions. We are a family-oriented, family-operated business that understands all that goes into planning for any event.

We aim to create everlasting memories from start to finish. Our team is passionate about every project and pours that passion into each celebration. Planning for any event should be exciting! We offer competitive pricing packages, assistance with creating unique and intimate designs tailored to your vision. Let's connect and create the event of your dreams, the stress-free way!

Our Promise

We coordinate directly with hotel staff to ensure seamless access and setup. All our decorations are hotel-safe (no permanent installations), and we handle complete cleanup after your celebration. Every package is customizable to match your color scheme and occasion theme. We strive to provide excellent service and extreme detail to all your planning needs, keeping things running smoothly from planning A to Z.

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about our services

Do you travel?
Yes, we do travel to surrounding counties of Nashville, TN.
Do you service Airbnbs?
Yes, we service Airbnbs in the Nashville area. All Airbnbs must be self-check in only. There is an additional $30 fee for Airbnb services.
What is your booking policy?
Book appointments on the app using the Book Now feature. We will respond to you within 24 hours of completing the booking.

A 50% non-refundable deposit is required to book your appointment. The remaining payment is due 48 hours before your appointment date.

Any booking made 3 days or less before the requested date is considered a last-minute booking and will require an additional $50 fee.
What is your refund policy?
All deposits are non-refundable. Your deposit goes toward your décor and once made it will not be refunded under any circumstances.

Your remaining balance can be refunded if you cancel within 24 hours after paying your remaining balance. Same-day cancellations will not be refunded.

If in unfortunate circumstances you do need to cancel your décor appointment, you have the option to reschedule your appointment for up to 90 days from your initial appointment date. Please notify us of the date you would like to reschedule within 14 days of the day you cancel.
What forms of payment do you accept?
We accept Zelle, Cash App, Venmo, and Credit Cards.
